88 Arkansas #326 -- BRAND NEW Modern Studio in Potrero Hill

PLEASE READ THE BELOW NOTES PRIOR TO INQUIRING:
*NO PARKING AVAILABLE
**NO VIRTUAL SHOWINGS OR SOMEONE COMING IN PLACE TO VIEW. ANYONE INTERESTED MUST BE PHYSICALLY PRESENT FOR IN-PERSON VIEWING PRIOR TO APPLYING
*Available now
**THERE IS NO GYM IN THE BUILDING**

DESCRIPTION:
-Brand new unit never been occupied
-Third floor unit facing courtyard
-Wood flooring
-In-unit washer and dryer
-Modern kitchen has Bertazzoni gas cooktop and electric convection ovens, Bertazzoni dishwasher, paneled Bosh refrigerator, and custom Barbosa cabinetry with quartz countertops, elegant tile backsplash, and under cabinet lighting
-Bathrooms have Barbossa custom cabinets, quartz countertops, Grohe fixtures, tiled shower, and LED backlit mirror
-Building amenities include roof deck with views and yoga area, elegant lobby with lobby attendant, package room, butterfly intercom entry, and bike storage
-Storage locker available for $100/month

LOCATION:
Great Potrero Hill location only a few blocks from 18th Street with many resturants, cafes, and local retail shops. Close proximity to Mission Bay, Dog Patch, Inner Mission, and the Design District. Easy freeway access!

OTHER DETAILS:
-No smoking
-Tenant pays for electricity and water
-Sorry, no pets
-Minimum lease term is 12 months
-Deposit is equal to one month rent
